record.title: Isolate private native controls from unused Frida prerequisites
record.intent: Remove the witnessed preflight coupling without changing the frozen native observation question.

Exercise the actual prerequisite function with private mode and absent Frida, and retained-mode positive, changed artifact, missing launcher and wrong-version controls. Recheck runtime health routing and production indexing for all new inputs.

Freeze a distinct private-adc-sequence-02 manifest with the same twelve native arms, source pins, final health and complete index audit. Support explicit frozen manifest selection and bind the suite audit to its externally supplied digest and run identity. Commit and push before execution.
